option_relations.rationale: Polymorphous light eruption does not match the clinical presentation and laboratory findings
Polymorphic light eruption is another term for polymorphous light eruption, which does not match the clinical presentation and laboratory findings
Juvenile spring eruption (JSE) associated with parvovirus B19 infection may present with similar skin lesions, but the exact relationship to erythema multiforme is unclear
Parvovirus B19-associated photodermatitis is not a well-established diagnosis, and the clinical presentation does not match the provided information
